content: We experiment with statistical N-gram language models BIBREF23 and neural Transformer-XL BIBREF11 models. Our best results use acoustic and word-level N-gram language models to generate a candidate list using beam search with a width of 2048. Next, an external Transformer-XL LM rescores the final list. All LMs were trained on datasets independently from acoustic models. We show results with the neural LM in our Results section. We observed a strong correlation between the quality of the neural LM (measured by perplexity) and WER as shown in Figure FIGREF20 .
